tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Cut loci in flat torus and cylinder] 1. ch13:2.5On the flat torus $T$ obtained by identifying opposite sides of a quadrilateral $ABCD$, the cut locus of $A$ is the set formed by the medians of the segments $BA$ and $BC$; the conjugate locus is empty. Similarly, the cut locus of a point $p$ of a cylinder in $\mathbb {R}^3$ is the "opposite generator" to that through $p$. \end{example}
